description: This PHP source file defines the 'Country' controller class for the administrative event handling in an OpenCart project. It includes methods to add, edit, and delete country data, each of which schedules tasks related to country data management by adding tasks through the model_setting_task. The class is part of the Opencart\Admin\Controller	ext oo namespace and extends a base Controller class.

classes.name: Country
classes.description: Controller handling country-related events for add, edit, and delete operations, scheduling corresponding tasks in the backend.

methods.name: addCountry
methods.description: Schedules tasks to generate the country list and info page when a new country is added.

methods.name: editCountry
methods.description: Schedules tasks to regenerate country list and specific country info when a country is edited.

methods.name: deleteCountry
methods.description: Schedules tasks to update the country list and delete the specified country when a country is deleted.
